title: Strict counit projection for perfect quotient coefficients
statement: For small sites X,Y, a geometric morphism f, commutative Noetherian ring A and ideal I [def-pur-adic-site-strict-quotient-interface], assume PerfectQuotients A I: each A/I^(n+1) is a perfect A-complex. For every unbounded derived module object F on X, the whole strict towerProjection f A I F is invertible. The map is the prescribed counit transpose of reductionPullIso, derived on the strict tower category before evaluation.

source.place: Tag 0944 (lemma-projection-formula), followed by the strict diagram cohomology criterion, Tags 0940 and 0941 (lemma-derived-limit-is-ok).

proof.text: Apply the single-level perfect-quotient projection theorem independently at every positive level, using the corresponding component of PerfectQuotients.

source.place: Tag 0944, applied separately at each level.

proof.text: Exact evaluation commutes with derived cohomology. Thus every component of every cohomology map is invertible. Strict tower maps are isomorphisms componentwise. The unbounded derived cohomology criterion makes the whole towerProjection invertible; this detects only isomorphisms, not equality of derived arrows.

source.place: Tags 0940 and 0941, strict tower abelianness and cohomology.
